title: North Vancouver Man Dies After RCMP Shooting
article: Initial reports indicated Matthew John Wilcox would likely survive the shooting that followed a high-speed chase near Deep Cove Saturday.

But on Sunday evening, the 39-year-old died in hospital while recovering from surgery. Vancouver Police Const. Lindsey Houghton said the B.C. Coroner's Service will be doing an autopsy to determine the exact cause of death.
Wilcox had been released from the custody by North Van RCMP right before the shooting incident.

"The investigation into the shooting is still very active and under investigation by the Vancouver Police Major Crime Section. Anyone who may have witnesses the incident or has pertinent information related to the incident and has yet to speak to investigators is asked to call 604-717-2500," Houghton said.
VPD Major Crime is handling the investigation of the shooting by a Mountie who had four years on the job.
